verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API for assigning users to variants for experiments/rollouts/releases (mixpanel-docs-36), and it has a hosted MCP server (mixpanel-docs-10) with tools listed for creating dashboards and querying analytics via natural language (mixpanel-docs-11, mixpanel-docs-19). However, there is no evidence the MCP server exposes flag creation/targeting/toggle tools, nor documentation of full CRUD (create/toggle) via the Feature Flags API beyond variant assignment. Missing for 10: MCP tool list showing flag create/target/toggle actions, API docs confirming flag creation and toggling (not just assignment).
